title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode4 Still Not There Yet

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That should be good for practice today.
Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yikes! No more!
My fingers are cramping up...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. To be fair, Saki, your part is pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, make sure you ice your hands so that you don't get tendonitis.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah, I forgot!
Thanks, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... It'd be awful to get injured just before our show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still need more time to practice. My fingers really freeze up when I ice my hands.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but resting is just as important, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But...
I'm still terrible. I really don't want to fall even further behind than I already am...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wait, that's right...!
I have a way to help everybody out...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So about coming up with our own song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I wasn't able to come up with anything new.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me neither...
I thought about it afterward when I got home, but drew a complete blank...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I could only come up with one, and even then, it's just copying this band I listen to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about you, Saki? Did you manage to come up with something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa! Look!
I've got a bunch here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What...?!
You mean all of these, Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
One, two, three...
You made ten?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I got so many good ideas last night, and I wrote them all down!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's incredible, Saki.
There's so many...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right. All of these in one night...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't I amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to hear some of them. Mind playing one for us, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! I'll play some right now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And that's the last one.
What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I thought they all sounded really nice but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly...
They sounded modern like they were made to become popular...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't put my finger on it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I have a hard time imagining us playing any of these during an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Us during an actual show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's so strange too. These melodies are so well made too, and I wouldn't be surprised if I heard these played for a music show on TV...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they even sound cool but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo! Why is this so hard?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry, Saki! I know it's a little unfair for us to say anything like that since we didn't really contribute...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Each phrase was put together really well and I could tell that a lot of thought went into them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if we can't agree on it as a band, they won't really be our songs... *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need for you to feel rushed. We agreed that it's going to take time for us to come up with our own songs, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our song to be the best it can be too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree with Ichika, and thank you for doing this for us, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then how about we use Saki's work as a basis next time to think about what kind of music we want to play as a band...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let's sleep on it and see what we all come up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
And I'll keep doing my best to come up with something that really hits home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's a small step forward, but I'm helping everybody out...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I spent so much time on these yesterday...)
That night
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I focused on melodies yesterday, so I could try thinking about chords today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, let's do that!
Maybe it'll sound more original then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, time to get to work!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to try making a few more, but I feel like I'm all over the place now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This isn't working...
What can I do to make it better?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like I'm close, but none of them still sound right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really thought that I'd be able to help everyone by doing this too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It might be because we don't know exactly what kind of music we want to play yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The kind of music we want to play...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come to think about it, what kind of music do I want to play...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We decided to go pro together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I don't think I ever thought about what exactly I wanted to try playing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's like nothing's going the right way now...
